integrity: The stated theorem is proved by exact Euclidean-coordinate and vertex-scaling identities; the one-parameter iff condition follows from a factored polynomial equation. No formal proof is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean barycentric metric construction on a single triangle and along one one-vertex conformal ray only. Neither all subdivision metric rules nor the general preserving-scheme problem are classified.
title: Barycentric subdivision is rigid along a one-vertex discrete-conformal ray
